topic: Admiral Fujitora held back against Sabo on Dressrosa and effectively bet on the Revolutionary
title: Fujitora Held Back Against Sabo For A Reason
description: Admiral Fujitora versus Sabo on Dressrosa: why chapters 750 to 757 read like an admiral who chose not to win. My read on the gamble he talks about with Sabo.
comment: Did Fujitora really hold back to protect Luffy, or was Sabo just that strong right out of the Colosseum?

lines.text: Fujitora went easy on Sabo, and chapter 757 shows it.

shot.fallback: blind admiral with a cane facing a flaming revolutionary

lines.text: Sabo walks away with a few bruises, and he says himself he suspects the admiral was holding back.

shot.search: Sabo suspects Fujitora holding back chapter 757
shot.fallback: man in a top hat studying a calm admiral

lines.text: Then he turns gravity sideways, and Sabo bursts into flames and charges straight through it.

shot.search: Fujitora Gravito Moko horizontal gravity Sabo flames
shot.fallback: man charging through sideways gravity in fire

lines.text: Here's what I think people skip. Fujitora says he's willing to bet his life on this fight.

shot.search: Fujitora bet his life fight Sabo
shot.fallback: admiral raising his cane in a solemn pose

lines.text: And the result is Sabo free to keep guarding Luffy, while the Marines stay stuck behind him.

shot.search: Sabo blocks Marines New King's Plateau Luffy
shot.fallback: fiery man holding a bridge against soldiers

lines.text: People say he was just bluffing. But an admiral who wanted Sabo stopped doesn't wish him luck.

shot.search: Fujitora Sabo respect Dressrosa end fight
shot.fallback: two warriors lowering their guard in the rubble

lines.text: Here's my read. Fujitora used a Revolutionary to hold the line, so he never had to chase Luffy himself.

shot.search: Fujitora lets Luffy fight Doflamingo Birdcage
shot.fallback: admiral looking up at a giant cage of strings

lines.text: And that's only a sliver of why a man like Sabo keeps winning battles that whole crews lose.

shot.search: Sabo Revolutionary Army chief of staff flame
shot.fallback: man in a top hat, flames behind him

lines.text: Which is the only way to explain why

shot.fallback: admiral with a faint smile in the evening light
